techcrunch.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
techcrunch.description: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.

techcrunch.title: Google launches AI voice features in Gmail, Docs, and Keep
techcrunch.description: Users can search for emails or draft documents using the new conversational feature.

techcrunch.title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
techcrunch.description: WeatherNext 3 is the latest wave of a sea change in meteorology brought out by deep learning techniques. Google says it will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.
